title: Sunflashes Column
article: The death of a Norway House man while in custody might have been prevented had RCMP sought medical attention sooner, Judge Brian Colli said in an inquest report.
Sherrill Wilfred Forbister, 50, died in October 2003 after police arrested the extremely intoxicated and unresponsive man at a house party.
RCMP officers took Forbister to the police station where they discovered he wasn't breathing. They performed CPR until an ambulance arrived more than 20 minutes later.
